result.summary: No critical blockers found. The page mostly renders correctly, but there are minor horizontal-overflow/clipping issues in the category chips and restaurant carousels that make content look cut off, plus some low-contrast secondary text.

issues.description: The category filter row is clipped at the right edge, with only a sliver of the next pill visible after “Healthy”, making the row look unintentionally cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add end padding, a fade/scroll indicator, or snap behavior so partially visible chips are clearly intentional and tappable.

issues.description: In “Fastest near you”, the third card is partially off-screen and its title is truncated as “Trattoria Piccol…”, which can read as broken rather than a deliberate carousel peek.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent card peek width, ellipsize long restaurant names cleanly, and ensure the off-screen card has enough visible context to signal horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: Secondary metadata such as delivery fees and time ranges uses small light-gray text that may be hard to read on white background.
issues.suggestion: Increase text contrast and/or font size for metadata to meet WCAG AA contrast guidance.
